name: Rune Lord
source:
Seigi is just an average but passionate student, who is addicted to manga and anime. He also belongs to the virtual club. The club is like the anime club or manga club, just watching anime videos or enjoying plastic models.

One day, he sees a UFO flying down to his school. To check it, he sneaks into school at night and finds a huge robot...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
正义只是个普通却充满热情的学生，沉迷漫画与动画。他还参加了虚拟社团。这个社团类似动画社或漫画社，平时只是观看动画影片、摆弄塑料模型。

一天，他看见一架UFO降落在学校。为了查明真相，他深夜潜入校园，发现了一台巨大机器人…

[摘自ErogeShop]
